captions.instagram:
How do you build your triceps?

The triceps is the biggest muscle in your upper arm, and one of its three heads crosses your shoulder. Raise the arm overhead and watch that head stretch, work out how much of you your hands carry in a push-up, a dand and a dip, and see what the evidence says about growing it safely.

→ The triceps has three heads that share one tendon on the point of your elbow.
→ Only the long head crosses your shoulder, so raising the arm overhead stretches it.
→ Trained overhead, beginners grew about 40% more triceps in 12 weeks in one study.
→ In a push-up your toes are the pivot, and your hands carry about two-thirds of you.
→ The dand of Indian akharas swoops low and arches up, loading the arms all the way.

youtubeLong.title: How do you build your triceps? (interactive explainer)
youtubeLong.description:
The triceps is the biggest muscle in your upper arm, and one of its three heads crosses your shoulder. Raise the arm overhead and watch that head stretch, work out how much of you your hands carry in a push-up, a dand and a dip, and see what the evidence says about growing it safely.

▶ Play with the interactive version: https://glassbox.how/e/tricepsclear/
⌘ Source code (MIT): https://github.com/bdeeps/tricepsclear

In this video:
• Three heads, one tendon. The triceps brachii fills the back of the upper arm.
• Arm up, long head long. Only the long head crosses the shoulder, so raising the arm overhead stretches it.
• Push-ups, dands and dips. In a push-up your toes are the pivot and your hands carry about two-thirds of your weight; force plates measured about 64%.
• How it grows. Hard sets close to failure, about 10 or more a week, on 2 or more days, with loads anywhere from about 30% to 85% of your max.
• Safely. See a doctor first with heart disease, high blood pressure, pregnancy or a recent injury.
• From the akhara to the lab. Indian wrestlers trained with dands and baithaks in earth pits; Gama's huge daily counts are reports, not records.
